messages:
sara_mkt: Quick update 1:30 - finished the Kitewell customer interview. They gave a tight line that could headline the case post: "Redwood helped us halve inference spend without impacting latency." I think it's punchy but legal might prefer softer language. Also need to lock webinar date + registration routing. Who can take legal + SFDC routing?

ben_p: Nice. Can you drop the raw transcript snippet and attach the 20s clip? I'll make a 15s social teaser once we have approval.

sara_mkt: Raw: "With Redwood, we cut inference spend by ~50% and latency stayed consistent even under load." Uploading audio now.

laura_legal: Heads-up: absolutes like "50%" are risky unless the customer explicitly signed off on that figure in writing. Recommend edit to: "significantly reduced inference spend while maintaining stable latency" and confirm with their comms. Also need the signed advocacy release before publish.

amy_cs: They signed the standard release last week. I'll ping their PR for attribution and confirm the softened quote.

ben_p: For the webinar: plan to collect registrants into SFDC campaign "Kitewell_Case_Launch_24" and trigger the 1-day + 7-day nurture. Tom, can you provision the form and map fields? We want company, role, use_case, interest_score, and utm tags.

tom_se: Yup. I'll deploy a HubSpot embedded form (we still use HubSpot for webinars). Field mapping to SFDC: email -> Contact.Email, company -> Account.Name, role -> Contact.Title, use_case -> Lead.Description, interest_score -> Lead.Score. Will add utm_source/medium/campaign. Do we need attended boolean?

ben_p: Add attended_webinar:Y/N. Also webhook to our lead enrichment service for firmographic data.

laura_legal: Once you have the final quote wording, attach the signed release and note the exact attribution line (name + title) as provided by Kitewell. We must not paraphrase names/titles.

sara_mkt: Amy confirms PR cleared the softer wording and provided attribution: "Jordan Lee, VP Platform, Kitewell". They also requested we include a link to Kitewell's public benchmark repo in the post. No embargo.

amy_cs: PR also asked that we avoid calling out competitors and to keep technical details high-level. They've approved the audio clip for a 15s teaser.

ops-bot: Reminder: publish checklist for marketing content: advocacy release attached, comms approval, SFDC campaign created, landing page reviewed, assets uploaded to CDN.

tom_se: SFDC campaign created: Kitewell_Case_Launch_24 (ID: SF-8402). HubSpot form created and embedded URL: https://info.redwood.ai/kitewell-case. Webhook configured to enrichment service at https://hooks.redwood.ai/enrich.

ben_p: I'll sketch two headline options for social A/B: Option 1: "How Kitewell cut LLM unit costs with Redwood" Option 2: "Kitewell9s playbook: lowering inference spend and keeping latency steady" Which reads better for LinkedIn?

sara_mkt: Option 1 is punchier for LinkedIn/Twitter. Option 2 might work better on the long-form blog/landing. We'll A/B both in paid promos.

laura_legal: Legal sign-off complete. Attached signed release and redline notes. We approved the softened quote: "Redwood significantly reduced our per-inference costs while maintaining stable latency during peak traffic." Please use the attribution exactly as Kitewell provided.

amy_cs: Kitewell comms confirmed and gave an OK on the final landing copy. No additional approvals pending.

ben_p: Landing page draft uploaded to Figma. Sara, can you review and confirm microcopy for the CTA and the quote block? I9ll wire up the social creatives once you sign off.

sara_mkt: Reviewing now. CTA options: "Register for the webinar" vs "See the case study + webinar". Leaning to the latter to capture both audiences.

ben_p: Good call. Timeline: publish post + open registration Monday 09:00 PT, paid promos Monday afternoon, webinar scheduled Thursday 10:00 PT. Amy, can you coordinate a short speaker prep with Kitewell (15m) the day before?

amy_cs: Done. Speaker prep booked Wed 16:00 PT. I'll send calendar invites.

tom_se: All tracking set. I9ll verify that the attended_webinar flag toggles via the HubSpot->SFDC sync after the event.

ben_p: Sweet. Final items: Sara attach the signed release to the CMS post, add link to Kitewell repo, and confirm final quote block. When you mark done I9ll schedule promos. :rocket:

sara_mkt: All attachments added, quote block updated, attribution set. Marking thread resolved. Thanks team! :tada:
